en: A black‑and‑white vintage photograph mounted on a postcard border, showing a busy town square or market. Numerous people in early 20th‑century European clothing mingle among horse‑ or ox‑drawn carts. In the background stands a large, rectangular neoclassical building with three stories, arched ground‑floor windows, and a simple hipped roof. Trees line part of the façade, and crowds are gathered along the front of the building. The overall scene suggests a livestock or produce market day in front of a civic or institutional building.
